Answer: E
Reason: The coronal CT image (Figure 1) shows a distinct, rounded hyperdense mass in the lateral aspect of the right mid-lung zone, consistent with the anatomical location of the right middle lobe. This lateral positioning and mass effect are characteristic of a pseudoaneurysm causing mild displacement of adjacent structures like the right lower lobe bronchus, distinguishing it from medial or upper lobe locations.
